NL2Repo-Bench focuses on repository-level generation from a single natural-language document, with no scaffolding or signatures, and uses the upstream repository’s official pytest suite as the sole evaluator
we curate a set of Python open-source libraries from GitHub as the targets to be reproduced
Correctness is strictly measured by executing the generated code against the original upstream tests
This design ensures an objective and binary notion of correctness grounded in real software behavior, rather than subjective judgments or proxy metrics
Each repository must contain 300 to 120,000 lines of code
We require each repository to have at least 10 GitHub stars
A repository must include pytest-based test cases, and its official version must successfully pass all of them
Only repositories that have been created or updated within the past three years are considered
